texts.title: The benefits of learning a second language
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: Learning a second language is one of the most rewarding things you can do. Research shows that bilingual people often have better memory and problem-solving skills than those who speak only one language. In addition, speaking another language opens up career opportunities. Many companies prefer employees who can communicate with international clients. However, learning a language requires time and patience. It is not something you can achieve overnight. Experts recommend practising a little every day rather than studying for hours once a week. The most important thing is to enjoy the process, because motivation is the key to success.

questions.question: What does the article say about bilingual people?
options: They often have better memory skills
They cannot learn a third language
questions.explanation: The article says bilingual people often have better memory and problem-solving skills.

options: Employees who can talk to international clients
questions.explanation: The article says many companies prefer employees who can communicate with international clients.

options: Studying for hours once a week
questions.explanation: The article says experts recommend practising a little every day.

questions.question: What is the key to success according to the article?
questions.explanation: The article says motivation is the key to success.

texts.title: A work email
texts.instructions: Read the email and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: Dear Mr. Johnson, I am writing to confirm our meeting next Thursday at 10 AM in the main conference room. I have prepared a presentation about the new marketing strategy. Could you please bring the sales figures from last quarter? I would also like to invite Ms. Garcia from the design team, as her input would be very valuable. The meeting should last approximately one hour. If you have any questions before then, please do not hesitate to contact me. Best regards, Anna Smith
